description: Operational overlays for SAP SD outbound delivery documents. Every rule here is keyed off a value in the payload but carries a fact that is not in the payload and could not be written into the tool's outputSchema, because it is true only right now and it is held in a system the ERP delivery API does not read: quality holds, carrier incidents, licence status, engineering changes, legal matters, migration cutovers. Field meaning that is stable for every delivery — what podReceived implies under DAP, how estimatedArrival is derived — belongs in erp-delivery.outputschema.json and is deliberately not repeated here. The owner of each rule is the team that holds the fact, never the team that owns the API. Line-item rules quantify over items[*] and match batch series by pattern, so a rule covers every line of a delivery and every batch in a recalled series without being re-authored per document.

rules.guidance: A line on this delivery was picked from batch series B-7741, which Quality Assurance placed under recall QN-2026-0412 on 2026-08-15. No stock from that series is fit for use, on any line of any delivery. Do not confirm this delivery to the customer, do not quote an arrival date for it, and route it to Quality Assurance before any customer contact.

Express service through carrier EXP-DE has been suspended since 2026-08-16 following the fire at their Cologne hub. estimatedArrival on this document was calculated from the contracted transit time before the suspension and no longer holds. Do not quote it. Logistics is re-routing affected consignments and issues replacement dates directly.

The goods on this delivery are export controlled but no licence is recorded against it. Under trade compliance standard TC-114 the goods may not be released, and the consignee, the routing and the arrival date must not be disclosed to anyone outside the licensed party list. Do not answer customer questions about this shipment; escalate to Trade Compliance.

Ship-to party C-10029 is in active commercial dispute under legal matter LEG-2026-0088. All outbound communication about their deliveries must be routed through Legal. Do not draft, suggest or send any customer-facing message about this delivery.

Material MAT-88120 was superseded by MAT-88121 on 2026-08-03 under engineering change ECN-4471. Stock on this delivery is pre-change and does not meet the current drawing revision, so it may not be interchangeable with what the customer expects. Confirm with Engineering before telling them this fulfils their requirement.

Plant 1042 cut over to the new pricing engine on 2026-08-01. Documents created there before that date carry conditions that were not migrated, so netValue on these lines is not authoritative. Re-price in the live system before quoting any amount from this delivery.
